target_data: string 2Welcome to town, Hunter !  Congratulations with the new badge.  You are required by law to be escorted by a veteran on your first missions.
string 6Hey Kid, nice to meet you!  I have been assigned your instructor.  We'll start with a training mission: Locate the slow moving target using your radar.  Then destroy it.
string 6Here's a little hint:  Move behind the target and get on his tail.  Do not unleash your weapons until you are in position.
string 6Nice kill!  Now let's try some larger weapons.  Find your way into the metro tunnels. Then pick up a bunch of homing missiles at the Downtown Station.
string 6Got'em?  Okay, the next target moves a bit faster. Make sure the missiles are locked before you fire them, and don't fire when the target is about to make a turn.
string 6Excellent, Hunter!  Now I have other jobs to do, so you'll have to deal with things on your own from now.  Welcome to business!
string 2Listen Hunter,  We have a public enemy roaming the streets of Downtown.  The area has been sealed off until the fugitive has been caught.
string 2Good job, Hunter !  You have secured the area.  The gates will now be opened.
string 1Attention all Hunters!  Two gang buggies are terrorizing the City Ring highway.  People are afraid to move from one part of town to another.  Go wipe them out!
string 1Well done.  We had to seal off Old Bronx to cut off their escape.  The gates will now be reopened.
string 3Greetings Hunter, quite impressive job there!  I have an easy job for you: I have had some trouble with a renegade smuggler.  Now he's hiding some- where in Downtown.  Please deal with him...
string 3Thank you, that was most pleasing!  Please enjoy the courtesy of my protection the next time you visit Old Bronx.
string 7Reports this morning indicate that Police forces have engaged in direct fight with gang members in Old Bronx.  Police Central reports of several killed and wounded.
string 5Hello Mister!  I have a small problem with a competitor who runs around Industrial Complex, selling illegal guns from his car.  Take care of the bandit and I shall reward you!
string 5Oh, very thank you Mister!  Always feel welcome in any of my humble shops!
string 2I see you are already learning the name of the game, Hunter.  Well, I have a delicate undercover mission for you.  You have to... punish a corrupted politician here in Downtown.
string 2Thank you, Hunter.  We'll have to fine you in order not to blow our cover, but don't worry, I will make it up to you later on!

string 7Minutes ago there was a development in the gang vs. Police conflict  A group of gangsters blasted through the gates around the old Central Stadium, killing at least 5 police officers in the process.
string 1Listen up Hunter!  A couple of gang kids are having a fight at the old stadium.  We will not tolerate this anymore!  Now go spoil that party.
string 1Well done!  Thank you for for disposing those cop killer scumbags.
string 3Listen Hunter,  Two police cars have entered Old Bronx.  Help me clean up my territory, and I'll owe you a favour!
string 3Thank you for cleaning up my neighborhood!  You should think about doin' some more work for me, Hunter.
string 7Police and Tax Authorities today expressed concern that a large in- crease in smuggling activities has been observed in the Space Port.
string 1We have reports on a shipload of illegal weapons coming into The Docks area.  Please find and destroy the cargo, and watch out... it may be guarded!
string 1Thank you, Hunter.  A bit messy, perhaps, but a nice job nevertheless.
string 1From the contents of the container we have been able to track the smuggler himself.  Now hunt him down!
string 2Excellent job, Hunter!  This should keep the smugglers down for a while!  The city wishes to express its gratitude!
string 3Please come to the Space Port!  A group of BHunters are trying to intercept one of my incoming arms shipments.  If you take them out I shall reward you.
string 3Thanks for protecting my freight ship.  Feel free to pick up a souvenir from the cargo room!
string 6Hi Kid!  I just upgraded my stun gun - maybe you could use the old one?  Pick it up at the Downtown Metro Station!
string 6Glad you could use it.  Just remember you owe me a favor, Kid.
string 2The mining tunnels at the Industrial Complex has collapsed in an earth quake.  We need the assistance of everybody to blast away the rocks!
string 2Thank you for getting our very important mining industry up and running again so quickly!
string 7The city today witnessed the return of notorious BHunter Edgar 'Shallow Death' Oval.  The Mayor expresses grave concern about the return of this radical crime fighter.
string 8Hey Scumbag!  Who do you think you are? I really don't like you!  Meet me at the Central Stadium, I challenge you to death!!!
string 6I just heard some rumours that a gang called "Buddha's Devils" want you dead!  They hired both Archibald and Edgar Oval to do the job, so watch your back!
string 6Gee Kid, you were quite lucky to survice that one!  Old Archibald was one of the meanest hunters around!
string 1We need you to bring in Mr. Luciano's accountant for questioning!  He is in Old Bronx.  Just paralyze him with your stun ray, then we'll come by and pick him up.
string 7A famous mob accountant was today killed just as Police was taking him into custody.  Rumours say that the crime boss fired the killing shot himself.

string 3I need you to do me a favor, Hunter.  A new gang is forming in the Underground City, and they are messing with my interests. There is a hidden entry in the sewers under The Docks. Make a reconnaissance flight down there!
string 3Thanks Hunter, I owe you a favor!  Now get your car out of there before someone spots you!
string 9How dare you show up here after killing Archibald, my beloved kid brother?  MEN, GET HIM!  Block the exits!!!
string 9You... you...! I'll get to you!  You keep watching your back Hunter, because I WILL kill you one day!!!
string 1We decided to come down on Luciano real hard now!  We believe he conducts his business from the Arezzo building in the Financial District.  Take out all four up-link antennas on the building!
string 1Good job, Hunter.  We appreciate that you support law and order in this city!
string 3Hey, Hunter!  I owe you a favor, remember?  Come down to the old Industrial Complex;  I just got a crate of plasma guns - I want you to have one!
string 3OK, you seem tougher than the rest - I'll let you live.  But don't EVER mess with me again!
string 3So you thought you could get away with messing with my Arezzo business, huh?  I think I have to teach you a lesson!
string 6Hey Kid, we gotta talk, but I can't broadcast this all over town!  Please meet me at the Downtown Metro Station.
string 6Listen carefully;  Something is going completely wrong in the Police force.  The Captain has been issuing some strange missions lately, so watch your back, Son!
string 5Attention all hunters!  I have a crate of 12 especially cheap nitro crackers for sale to the first hunter on the spot.  Hurry to my main store in Chinatown!
string 5I enjoyed that!  You fully deserve the weapons; now come and pick them up in my little hardware shop.
string 5Welcome Hunter!  Looks like you have to fight for the hardware. I will sell to the winner!

string 2I have to send the plans for my next out-of-town trip to my driver, but I can't trust our Comm-Link anymore!  I uploaded the docs in your onboard com- puter, please bring them to the Space Port for me!
string 2Thank you, Hunter.  At least there is SOMEONE around here I can trust!
string 3Hunter!  A large police force is raiding my casinos at Grand Vegas.  Come down and help me stop them!
string AHi Kid, "Shallow Death" Oval here!  Seems like you've got the stuff! Nice job you did in Vegas...  It's nearly too bad I have to kill you;  See you around!
string 3Great job!  I hope you won't get into too much trouble with the Police Captain for this - she has been acting strange lately.
string 1In the scrap yards under The Docks we have discovered a suspicious-looking container.  Please check it out!
string 1I see you teamed up with Luciano again. I don't like that!  Remember who is in charge little man, or I'll have your ass!  Strip him of his heavy gear, boys.
string 1Hello Hunter, having a bad day?  Cheer up, I won't kill you... I just want you to know who runs this city - and believe me, it is NOT the Mayor!
string BHail Dennan, leader of Buddha's Devils!  I will revenge the death of his brother!  Hihi hehe haaa!
string 7Today the Mayor rushed home from his out-of-town trip and hurried directly to the City Hall.  He had no comments on the rumours of an increased instability inside the walls.

string 2I am afraid I need your trusted services again - I can't trust anyone at City Hall!  You must hide some documents for me in a secret tunnel complex.  There's a hidden entry on the backside of City Hall. Don't let anyone follow you!
string 2Thank you so much Hunter!  Now better get out of there before somebody spots you again...
string 1Identify yourself, trespasser!  You are not permitted access to this area!  Get him, Guards!
string 1Get to the mines!  The recent gold strike made several BHunters collaborate in an attempt to over-run the mine.  Get down there, secure the gold and kill the rebel scum!
string 1What have you done, you fool !?!  I will have your head for this...
string 6Hello there...  I know you've been hired by the police bitch captain but why don't you join us instead?  We could use a great leader, and in return we'll pay you half the gold we find!

string 5Hello Hunter.  My sources at City Hall has leaked that a valuable shipment of Micro-Nuclear shells will be transported via the City Ring. Intercept, collect and return the shells to me in Chinatown!
string 5Thank you, Hunter!  It seems like I may need them in the time to come.  Grab yourself some ammunition at my store!

string 7Police coupe at the City Hall:  It seems the Police Captain has made an attempt to overthrow the government of this city. She has declared the city into a state of emergency, and practically holds the entire downtown as hostage!
string 5Great, you got the shells.  Now, deliver them to me in Chinatown and I will pay you handsomely.
string 6DISTRESS CALL INCOMING:  I need your help desperately!  'Shallow Death' Oval has caught up with me down in Industrial!  He is just too tough for me, please help!!

string AHi Kid, Oval here!  Too bad you missed the show! But then there wasn't much to see... Your friend was an easy kill.  Here, have fun with my friends while I take a nap. You and I will have to play another day!
string 3Please help us open up Downtown again!  We'll have to make a head-on attack and blast our way through!  I hope you have some Static Coating ready!
string 3Thank you, very nicely done!  No wonder the rebel BHunters chose you as their leader!

string 5I am helping a group of BHunters to secure the Space Port and lock down all incoming transports!  This is to cut off reinforcements to that crazy Police Captain.  Please help us clean out all police cars in The Docks!
string 1Now you've done it!  You son of a Swine...  You have crossed me for the last time, Hunter!

string 3It seems like you're attracting enemies like flies to sugar! How about making some real work for a change? I have a problem with a casino owner in Grand Vegas.  Please demolish the statue in front of his casino!
string 3Woah!  That blast should shake some of his regular customers off for a while!
string 7Rumour has it that the Mayor may have escaped the clutches of the Police and is now trying to get out of the city.
string AHi Kid, Oval here!  Come meet me at the Central Stadium.  I'll try to be gentle, but I can't promise it won't hurt!
string 7A heavy one-on-one combat was conducted at the Stadium today.  Speculations that this was the famed Edgar Oval in action cannot at this time be confirmed.
string 2Dear Hunter.  I have one ... final request that will earn you all the rest of ... my money.  Pick me up at ... the Underground City and take me to the Space Port.
string 2Watch out, Hunter, it's a setup! They forc#%...
string 9Thank you for coming to your own funeral!  KILL HIM MEN!
string CHey, we heard your distress call.  I hope we are not too late!
string COh no, I think Dennan got away!  NO WAIT! He is targeted on the radar.  Hurry up, catch him!
string 3Greetings Hunter.  I have heard rumors that the Captain herself will be patrolling the city for the next few weeks.  I suggest we make our move now, and strike while we have the chance!
string 1What of it Punk!  Now I am here at the Stadium, come fight me if you dare.  Bring all your pitiful friends,  they are no match for my troops anyway!
string CYou did it!  We lost many good men, but you beat that corrupted police force in the end!
string 3Either way, we are facing an interesting future, united.  Well done, Hunter.  You are made of the Right Stuff!
string 3A number of people moved for me as the new Mayor.  How would you like to run a new division of BHunters, replacing the old police force?
string 3Good job, Hunter!  I think we will build a new government for this city, where everybody has a say!
